'''General Mills''' is a mentioned character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] who heads up the [[Jetpack|classfied]] [[Black Project]] in [[Area 69]]. Protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] later steals the jetpack for his friend, aging hippie and conspiracy theorist [[The Truth]]. His name is most likely a reference to the [[wikipedia:General Mills|General Mills]] food marketing company.
